contracts.name: replacePathSeparator
contracts.signature: function replacePathSeparator(path: string, oldSeparator: string, newSeparator: string): string

preconditions: Text arguments contain at most 64 Unicode code points each and no lone surrogate code units. Indices and lengths count code points, not UTF-16 units. Inputs are unchanged; returned arrays are fresh. OldSeparator is nonempty.
